breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the periodic grid convention with Nx=1024 points on [0,1), x_j = j*dx for j=0,...,Nx-1 with dx=1/Nx. The contradictory instruction about interpreting Nx as points including both endpoints with dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1) has been completely removed, matching the ground truth.
